Lean Build.name: Lean Build
Lean Build.description:
💪 Build: Lean Build
Low body fat with visible muscle definition — toned but not bulky. A body shaped by regular activity rather than dedicated weight training.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Lean Build.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Lean frame — low body fat, visible muscle tone without bulk. Tendons and bone structure readable through the skin, athletic without heaviness. Female: shoulders defined but close to the hip line, slim neck with a visible line, soft jaw, a light chest line above a visible waist. Male: shoulders wider than the hips, tendoned neck, sharp jaw, a flat chest with the ribs readable. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own structure stripped lean.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
